heading.text: The Player, three directions: Song 2, chorus looped at 80%, pass 3 (2194 × 1100, the throne's screen)

lamp.text: Lamp: a lit music stand in a dark room. Warm cream paper sits under the light, with the picture and the big numbers above it and everything else as quiet type. 2 lines × 4 bars, the loop as a brass bracket. Now set in a sans: Atkinson Hyperlegible Next.

console.text: Console: the notation gets a fixed column whose width never changes, three lines even with the video. Everything you touch sits in one rack beside it, like a drum module next to the kit. 3 lines × 3 bars on dark paper.

chart.text: Chart: read it like a printed drum part. The page is on top, the loop is pencilled in as real repeat signs, and a stage clock of big numbers runs along the bottom with the keys built in.

lampHeading.text: Lamp, in Atkinson Hyperlegible Next: every frame of the brief at 2194 × 1100

protoHow.text: Press Play on the artboard. Click a section on the song map to loop it; shift-click another to stretch the loop over both; click inside the loop to clear it. Step the tempo with the keys. Turn the ramp on and press End this pass (a stand-in for playing one) to watch it climb 5% every 2 passes up to 100%.
